variables.name: QYM_BASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL for the deployed qym platform used by the SDK, CLI, and platform server.

variables.name: QYM_API_KEY
variables.description: API key used by the SDK and CLI to stream runs and call protected platform endpoints.

variables.name: QYM_PLATFORM_DEBUG
variables.description: Enable platform client debug logging. Set to 1 for stderr logging or to a file path for file logging.

variables.name: QYM_JUDGE_MODEL
variables.description: Model identifier used by built-in LLM-as-judge metrics.

variables.name: QYM_JUDGE_API_KEY
variables.description: API key used by LLM-as-judge metrics.

variables.name: QYM_JUDGE_BASE_URL
variables.description: Optional base URL override for hosted or self-hosted LLM judge providers.

variables.name: LANGFUSE_HOST
variables.description: Langfuse host used when datasets or traces are backed by Langfuse.

variables.name: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.description: Langfuse public key used by SDK integrations.

variables.name: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Langfuse secret key used by SDK integrations.

variables.name: QYM_SHOW_SUMMARY
variables.description: Controls whether local result summaries are shown after a run.
